113.t:
The mistress of the women of the worlds in her time, the part of the Prophet's flesh, the kin of the Chosen One, ⟦2:118⟧ the mother of her father (1) , daughter of the master of creation, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, Abū al-Qāsim Muḥammad ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿAbd al-Muṭṭalib ibn Hāshim ibn ʿAbd Manāf, al-Qurashiyyah, al-Hāshimiyyah, and the mother of the two Ḥasans.
She was born a little before the Prophetic mission.
The Imam (الإمام) ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib married her in Dhū al-Qaʿdah, or a little before it, in the year 2 AH, after the Battle of Badr.
Ibn ʿAbd al-Barr said: He consummated the marriage with her after the Battle of Uḥud (2) , and she bore him al-Ḥasan, al-Ḥusayn, Muḥsin, Umm Kulthūm and Zaynab.
She narrated from: أبيها.
Narrating from her: ابنها؛ الحسين، وعائشة، وأم سلمة، وأنس بن مالك، وغيرهم.
Her narrations are in the Six Books (الكتب الستة).
The Prophet ﷺ used to love her, honour her and confide in her.
Her virtues are abundant.
She was patient, religious, good, chaste, content, and grateful to Allah.
The Prophet ﷺ was angered on her behalf when it reached him that Abū al-Ḥasan had resolved upon what he considered permissible, namely proposing to the daughter of Abū Jahl, and he said: (By Allah, the daughter of the Prophet of Allah and the daughter of the enemy of Allah shall not be joined together; Fāṭimah is only a part of me: what troubles her troubles me, and what hurts her hurts me (3)) .
So ʿAlī abandoned the proposal out of regard for her, and he did not marry another wife alongside her, nor did he ⟦2:119⟧ take a concubine.
When she died, he married and took concubines (may Allah be pleased with both of them).
When the Prophet ﷺ died she grieved for him, wept for him and said: O my father! To Jibrīl we announce his death! O my father! He answered a Lord who called him! O my father! The Garden of Firdaws is his abode!
And she said after his burial: O Anas, how could your souls bear to throw dust upon the Messenger of Allah (1) ﷺ!
He had said to her in his illness: I will be taken in this illness of mine; and she wept.
And he told her that she would be the first of his family to join him, and that she was the mistress of the women of this Ummah.
So she laughed, and kept that secret.
When he ﷺ died, ʿĀʾishah asked her, and she told her what he had confided to her (2) .
ʿĀʾishah (may Allah be pleased with her) said: Fāṭimah came walking, her gait not differing in the least from the gait of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.
He stood up to her and said: (Welcome, my daughter (3)) .
When her father died, her hopes were attached to his inheritance, and she came to request that from Abū Bakr al-Ṣiddīq, and he narrated to her:
that he had heard the Prophet ﷺ say: (We are not inherited from; what we leave ⟦2:120⟧ is charity (1)) .
She was displeased with him, then she fell ill (2) .
روى: إسماعيل بن أبي خالد، عن الشعبي، قال:
When Fāṭimah fell ill, Abū Bakr came and asked permission to enter.
ʿAlī said: O Fāṭimah, this is Abū Bakr asking permission to come in to you.
She said: Would you like me to give him permission?
He said: Yes.
-I say: She acted according to the Sunnah (السنة) (may Allah be pleased with her), for she did not give permission in her husband's house except by his command-.
He said: So she gave him permission.
He went in to her seeking to win her favour, and said: By Allah, I did not leave home, wealth, family and kin except seeking the pleasure of Allah and His Messenger, and your pleasure, O People of the House.
He said: Then he kept seeking to please her until she was pleased (3) .
She died five months, or about that, after the Prophet ﷺ (4) .
She lived 24 or 25 years.
The most that has been said is that she lived 29 years. The first is ⟦2:121⟧ more correct.
She was younger than Zaynab, the wife of Abū al-ʿĀṣ ibn al-Rabīʿ, and than Ruqayyah, the wife of ʿUthmān ibn ʿAffān.
The lineage of the Prophet ﷺ has been cut off except through Fāṭimah, because Umāmah bint Zaynab, whom the Prophet ﷺ used to carry during his prayer (1) , married ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib, then after him al-Mughīrah ibn Nawfal ibn al-Ḥārith ibn ʿAbd al-Muṭṭalib al-Hāshimī, who had seen the Prophet, and she had children by him.
al-Zubayr ibn Bakkār said: The progeny of Zaynab died out.
It is authentically established that the Prophet ﷺ covered Fāṭimah, her husband and their two sons with a cloak and said: (O Allah, these are the people of my house; O Allah, remove impurity from them and purify them thoroughly (2)) .
أحمد بن حنبل: حدثنا تليد بن سليمان، حدثنا أبو الجحاف، عن أبي حازم، عن أبي هريرة:
The Prophet ﷺ looked at ʿAlī, Fāṭimah, al-Ḥasan and al-Ḥusayn and said: (I am at war with whoever wars against you, and at peace with whoever is at peace with you) (3) . ⟦2:122⟧
Narrated by: al-Ḥākim in (al-Mustadrak) .
And in it: by way of أبان بن تغلب، عن أبي بشر، عن أبي نضرة، عن أبي سعيد:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: (No one hates us, the People of the House, except that Allah will enter him into the Fire) (1) .
إسرائيل: عن ميسرة بن حبيب، عن المنهال بن عمرو، عن زر، عن حذيفة:
The Prophet ﷺ said: (An angel descended and gave me the glad tidings that Fāṭimah is the mistress of the women of the people of Paradise) .
It has been narrated by another route from al-Minhāl; al-Ḥākim narrated both of them (2) .
يحيى بن أبي كثير: عن أبي سلام، عن أبي أسماء، عن ثوبان، قال:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ entered upon Fāṭimah while I was with him, and she had taken from her neck a chain of gold, and she said: This was given to me as a gift by Abū Ḥasan.
He said: (O Fāṭimah! Would it please you that people should say: This is Fāṭimah bint Muḥammad, and in her hand is a chain of fire?) .
Then he went out, and she bought a slave boy with the chain and freed him (3) .
The Prophet ﷺ said: (Praise be to Allah, who has saved Fāṭimah from the Fire) . Narrated by Abū Dāwūd (4) . ⟦2:123⟧
داود بن أبي الفرات: عن علباء، عن عكرمة:
From Ibn ʿAbbās, raised (المرفوع): (The best of the women of the people of Paradise are Khadījah and Fāṭimah (1)) .
أحمد بن حنبل: حدثنا يحيى بن أبي زائدة، أخبرني أبي، عن الشعبي، عن سويد بن غفلة، قال: ʿAlī proposed for the daughter of Abū Jahl to her paternal uncle ⟦2:124⟧ al-Ḥārith ibn Hishām, and he consulted the Prophet ﷺ, who said: (Is it about her lineage that you are asking me?) .
ʿAlī said: I already know what her lineage is, but do you command me to marry her?
He said: (No; Fāṭimah is a morsel of flesh from me, and I can only reckon that she would be grieved, or distressed) .
He said: I will not do anything that you dislike (1) .
al-Tirmidhī narrated in (his Jāmiʿ) , from the hadith of ʿĀʾishah:
that she was asked: Which of the people was most beloved to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ?
She said: Fāṭimah, among the women; and among the men, her husband, and indeed, as far as I know, he was much given to fasting and to standing in prayer (2) .
I say: Its chain of transmission (الإسناد) is not that strong.
And in (al-Jāmiʿ), from Zayd ibn Arqam:
that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to the two of them and to their two sons: (I am at peace with whoever you are at peace with, and at war with whoever you war against) (3) .
Among her daughters were: Umm Kulthūm, the wife of ʿUmar ibn al-Khaṭṭāb, and Zaynab, the wife of ʿAbd Allāh ibn Jaʿfar ibn Abī Ṭālib.
الأعمش: عن عمرو بن مرة، عن أبي البختري، قال:
ʿAlī said to his mother: Spare Fāṭimah the service outside, and she will spare you the work in the house: the kneading, the baking and the grinding (4) .
عبد الرحمن بن أبي نعم: عن أبي سعيد:
From the Prophet ﷺ: (Fāṭimah ⟦2:125⟧ is the mistress of the women of the people of Paradise, except for Maryam bint ʿImrān (1)) .
علي بن هاشم بن البريد: عن كثير النواء، عن عمران بن حصين:
that the Prophet ﷺ visited Fāṭimah while she was ill, and said to her:
(How do you find yourself?) .
She said: I am in pain, and what adds to it is that I have no food to eat.
He said: (O my little daughter, are you not pleased to be the mistress of the women of the worlds?) .
She said: Then what of Maryam?
He said: (She is the mistress of the women of her world, and you are the mistress of the women (2) of your world. Indeed -by Allah- I have married you to a master in this world and the Hereafter) .
Narrated by: أبو العباس السراج، عن محمد بن الصباح، عن علي.
Kathīr is flimsy (واه), and a narrator has dropped out between him and ʿImrān.
علباء بن أحمر: عن عكرمة، عن ابن عباس:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: (The best of the women of the people of Paradise are: Khadījah bint Khuwaylid, Fāṭimah bint Muḥammad, Maryam and Āsiyah (3)) .
وروى: أبو جعفر الرازي، عن ثابت، عن أنس:
From the Prophet ﷺ, something similar, and its wording is: (The best of the women of the worlds are four) .
معمر: عن قتادة، عن أنس, raised (المرفوع): (Sufficient for you among the women of the worlds are four) ... , the hadith.
al-Tirmidhī graded this authentic (الصحيح), and it is: (Sufficient for you among the women of the worlds are: Maryam, Khadījah, Āsiyah bint Muzāḥim and Fāṭimah bint Muḥammad ﷺ) (4) . ⟦2:126⟧
أبو نعيم: حدثنا محمد بن مروان الذهلي، حدثنا أبو حازم، حدثني أبو هريرة:
that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: (An angel asked Allah's permission to visit me, and he gave me the glad tidings that Fāṭimah is the mistress of the women of my Ummah, and that al-Ḥasan and al-Ḥusayn are the two masters of the youth of the people of Paradise) .
Very gharīb (الغريب), and al-Dhuhlī narrates little (1) .
Something similar is also narrated from the hadith of Abū Hurayrah.
ميسرة بن حبيب: عن المنهال بن عمرو، عن عائشة بنت طلحة، عن عائشة أم المؤمنين، قالت:
I have not seen anyone more like the Messenger of Allah ﷺ in speech and conversation than Fāṭimah; when she came in to him he would stand up to her, kiss her and welcome her, and she would do the same with him (2) .
Maysarah: truthful (صدوق).
الزهري: عن عروة، عن عائشة، قالت:
Fāṭimah lived six months after the Prophet ﷺ, and she was buried at night (3) .
al-Wāqidī said: This is the most firmly established of the reports in our view.
He said: al-ʿAbbās prayed (4) over her, and he, ʿAlī and al-Faḍl went down into her grave. ⟦2:127⟧
Saʿīd ibn ʿUfayr said: She died on the night of Tuesday, when three nights had passed of the month of Ramaḍān, in 11 AH, aged 27 or thereabouts, and she was buried at night.
وروى: يزيد بن أبي زياد، عن عبد الله بن الحارث، قال:
Fāṭimah remained six months after the Prophet ﷺ, wasting away.
Abū Jaʿfar al-Bāqir said: She died three months after her father.
وعن ابن أبي مليكة، عن عائشة، قالت:
Between Fāṭimah and her father there were two months (1) .
And from Abū Jaʿfar al-Bāqir: that she died aged 28.
She was born while Quraysh were building the Kaʿbah.
He said: And ʿAlī washed her.
al-Musabbiḥī mentioned that ʿAlī married Fāṭimah four and a half months after the wedding of ʿĀʾishah, and Fāṭimah on that day was 15 years and five and a half months old.
قتيبة بن سعيد: حدثنا محمد بن موسى، عن عون بن محمد بن علي، عن أمه أم جعفر.
وعن عمارة بن مهاجر، عن أم جعفر:
that Fāṭimah said to Asmāʾ bint ʿUmays: I find repugnant what is done with women: a cloth is thrown over the woman, and it shows her shape (2) .
She said: O daughter of the Messenger of Allah, shall I not show you something I saw in Abyssinia?
So she called for fresh palm branches, bent them, then threw a cloth over them. ⟦2:128⟧
Fāṭimah said: How fine and beautiful this is! When I die, wash me, you and ʿAlī, and let no one come in to me.
When she died, ʿĀʾishah came to enter, and Asmāʾ said: Do not enter.
So she complained to Abū Bakr, and he came, stood at the door and spoke to Asmāʾ.
She said: She commanded me.
He said: Then do what she commanded you; then he left (1) .
Ibn ʿAbd al-Barr said: She was the first whose bier was covered in Islam in that manner.
إسماعيل بن أبي خالد: عن الشعبي، قال:
Abū Bakr came to Fāṭimah when she fell ill and asked permission to enter; she gave him permission, and he apologised to her and spoke to her, and she became pleased with him (2) .
روى: إبراهيم بن سعد، عن ابن إسحاق، عن علي بن فلان بن أبي رافع، عن أبيه، عن سلمى، قالت:
Fāṭimah fell ill ... , until she said: She lay down on her bed, faced the qiblah, then said:
By Allah, I am to be taken this very hour, and I have washed myself, so let no one uncover any part of me.
She died, and ʿAlī came, and I told him, and he buried her with that washing of hers (3) .
This is rejected (المنكر). ⟦2:129⟧
أبو عوانة: عن فراس، عن الشعبي، عن مسروق، حدثتني عائشة، قالت:
We, the wives of the Prophet ﷺ, were gathered with him; not one of them was left out.
Then Fāṭimah came walking, her gait not differing in the least from the gait (1) of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.
When he saw her, he welcomed her, saying: (Welcome, my daughter) .
Then he seated her on his right, or on his left, then spoke to her secretly, and she wept; then he spoke to her secretly a second time, and she laughed.
When he got up, I said to her: The Messenger of Allah singled you out with a secret, and yet you weep! I adjure you, by the right I have over you, to tell me: why did you laugh? And why did you weep?
She said: I would not divulge the secret of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.
When he died, I said to her: I adjure you, by the right I have over you, to tell me.
She said: As for now, yes. The first time, he told me: (that Jibrīl used to review the Qurʾān with him once every year, and that he had reviewed it with me this year twice, and that I can only reckon that to be at the approach of my term; so fear Allah and be patient, for I am an excellent forerunner for you) .
So I wept, and when he saw my distress, he said: (Are you not pleased to be the mistress of the women of the worlds, or the mistress of the women of this Ummah?) .
She said: So I laughed.
Recorded by: al-Bukhārī (2) , عن أبي نعيم، عن زكريا، عن فراس.
It is a singular, gharīb (الغريب) report. ⟦2:130⟧
محمد بن عمرو: عن أبي سلمة، عن عائشة:
that she said to Fāṭimah: Tell me about when you bent over the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and wept, then bent over him and laughed?
She said: He told me that he would die of his illness, so I wept; then he told me that I would be the quickest of his family to join him, and he said: (You are the mistress of the women of the people of Paradise, except Maryam bint ʿImrān) , so I laughed (1) .
ابن حميد: حدثنا سلمة، حدثنا ابن إسحاق، عن يحيى بن عباد، عن أبيه، عن عائشة، قالت:
I have not seen anyone more truthful in speech than Fāṭimah, except the one who fathered her (2) .
جعفر الأحمر: عن عبد الله بن عطاء، عن ابن بريدة، عن أبيه، قال:
The most beloved of women to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was Fāṭimah, and of men ʿAlī (3) .
إبراهيم بن سعد: عن أبيه، عن عروة، عن عائشة، حدثته:
that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ called Fāṭimah and spoke to her secretly, and she wept; then he spoke to her secretly, and she laughed.
I asked her, and she said: He told me of his death, so I wept; then he told me that I would be the first of his family to follow him, so I laughed (4) .
وروى: كهمس، عن ابن بريدة، قال:
Fāṭimah grieved for her father for seventy days and nights, and she said to Asmāʾ:
I am ashamed to go out tomorrow before ⟦2:131⟧ the men with my body showing through it.
She said: Shall we not make for you something I saw in Abyssinia?
So she made the bier, and she said: May Allah cover you as you have covered me (1) .
هلال بن خباب: عن عكرمة، عن ابن عباس، قال:
When “When the help of Allah and the victory come” (Qurʾān 110:1) was revealed, the Prophet ﷺ called Fāṭimah and said to her: His own death has been announced to him; and she wept.
He said: (Do not weep, for you will be the first of my family to join me) .
So she laughed (2) .
إسماعيل القاضي: حدثنا إسحاق الفروي، حدثنا عبد الله بن جعفر الزهري، عن جعفر بن محمد، عن عبيد الله بن أبي رافع، عن المسور بن مخرمة، قال:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: (Fāṭimah is only a branch of me: what gladdens her gladdens me, and what grieves her grieves me) (3) . ⟦2:132⟧
Gharīb (الغريب).
ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz al-Uwaysī narrated it, and differed from al-Farwī.
al-Ḥākim narrated this in (his Mustadrak) , as did Muḥammad ibn Zuhayr al-Nasawī, عن أبي سهل بن زياد، عن إسماعيل القاضي.
شعيب: عن الزهري، عن علي بن الحسين، أن المسور أخبره:
that ʿAlī (may Allah be pleased with him) proposed to the daughter of Abū Jahl; when Fāṭimah heard, she came and said:
Your people are saying that you do not become angry for your daughters, and here is ʿAlī about to marry the daughter of Abū Jahl.
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ stood up, and I heard him when he pronounced the testimony of faith, and he said: (To proceed: I gave Abū al-ʿĀṣ ibn al-Rabīʿ in marriage, and he spoke to me and was truthful to me. Fāṭimah is a part of me, and I hate that they should put her to trial; and indeed -by Allah- the daughter of the Messenger of Allah and the daughter of the enemy of Allah shall not be joined together with one man) .
So ʿAlī abandoned the proposal (1) .
Narrated by: الوليد بن كثير، حدثنا محمد بن عمرو بن حلحلة، عن الزهري, similarly.
In it is: (and I fear that she may be put to trial in her religion) .
ابن إسحاق: عن ابن قسيط، عن محمد بن أسامة، عن أبيه:
The Prophet ﷺ was asked: Which of the people is most beloved to you?
He said: (Fāṭimah (2)) .
It is narrated from Usāmah with another chain of transmission (الإسناد), and its wording is: Which of the people of your house is most beloved to you? ⟦2:133⟧
حماد بن سلمة: عن علي بن زيد، عن أنس:
that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to pass by the house of Fāṭimah for six months, when he went out for the dawn prayer, saying: (The prayer, O people of the house of Muḥammad*, “Allah only wishes to remove impurity from you, O People of the House, and to purify you thoroughly” ) . [al-Aḥzāb (1) : 33]
يونس بن أبي إسحاق، ومنصور بن أبي الأسود, and this is his wording:
سمعت أبا داود، سمعت أبا الحمراء يقول:
I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ come to the door of ʿAlī and Fāṭimah for six months, saying: “Allah only wishes ... ” the verse, [al-Aḥzāb (2) : 33] .
Among what is attributed to Fāṭimah, and is not authentic:
What harm is there for one who has smelled the soil of Aḥmad ... that he should not smell precious perfumes for the length of time
Calamities have been poured upon me which, had they ... been poured upon the days, would have turned them into nights
She has in (Musnad Baqī) : eighteen hadiths, among them one hadith agreed upon (المتفق عليه) (3) . ⟦2:134⟧
